notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/jumpei-arima__navigation_simulator_for_mobile_robot --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. The upstream clone is a legacy gym environment with numpy and the Cython raycasting extension (requirements.txt:1-2, setup.py:13-15); it was never installed or imported, so the fake backend is this package's pure Python stand-in for NsmrGymEnv and was not compared with the upstream environment. NOT COVERED: raycast lidar (the fake returns the full real length of 720 readings, robot.json:18, but every value is a placeholder at max_range), collisions (never reported by the fake), the upstream sensor/actuator noise, stuck and oversight events, and rendering (the fake render returns None). The 10 m x 10 m map (simple_map.json:2-3) is not rebuilt; the fake draws its start pose and target in that box. The upstream NsmrGymEnv.seed only assigns self.np_random while NSMR draws from numpy's global random module (nsmr.py:61-69, 107-108, 148-150, 168), so the upstream simulator is not reproducible from the seed; the fake uses Python random.Random and repeats a reset for one seed. Fidelity is F0 (kinematic 2D unicycle, no rigid-body dynamics or contacts), engine nsmr:2d-raycasting, timestep 100 ms (dt=0.1 s, nsmr.py:12-18), realtime_factor 0, lockstep, reset full, snapshot_restore false; the gaps list every omission. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset, so it deliberately makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values, seed of reset and seed of cap.world.seed.v1). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used; there are no extension ids, so no catalogue_requests. No limit is operator_required: the only bound is the Box action space the bridge derives from the environment (linear 0.0..1.0, angular -1.0..1.0 with the bundled robot.json:3-6). gate.digest is the digest line the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not a hand-edited package file.
